question: Is subject_is_reply a robust phishing cue or a corpus artifact?
interpretation: Reply-style subjects are strongly associated with legitimate mail in CEAS_08 (phi about -0.6), so the feature is a real but dataset-specific signal. Removing it barely changes test performance, so the model does not depend on the shortcut; the shortcut is available but redundant given the TF-IDF content features. Real phishing can spoof 'Re:', so this cue should not be trusted on out-of-distribution mail.
